scope: Fire-Lite and Silent Knight pictured families from original manufacturer publications held by the existing Manual Archives catalogue. No catalogue mutation.
source_policy: Technical identity and model scope come from original manufacturer-authored PDFs; FACP Manuals is their existing archive host. Images are extracted from those exact documents, never generated or substituted. Official Honeywell product/document pages independently corroborate the families.
image_transformations: Original raster image extraction or exact PDF product-area crop; blank white margin removal only. No invented hardware or synthetic face alterations.

panels.review: Full first pages and extracted product images visually inspected. Document labels distinguish the specific model; shared fascias are grouped with explicit scope limits.
